name: TPW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in an eight-man bracket printed on the fed's own premiere show; also called “World Champion” on air.

name: TPW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Contested in a tournament open to the whole roster, its final a Triangle match.

name: TPW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Contested in a tournament whose final became a Triangle Tag Team Cage Championship match.

name: TPW X-Treme Championship
epitaph: Decided in the “Xtreme Scramble,” a battle royale open to the entire roster.
